# Feeling to Jargon ### 你说感觉，Feeling to Jargon 帮你补全专业术语。

快速开始 · 渐进式索引 · 按需查询 · 添加新领域

## 它能做什么 你知道自己想要什么，但不知道怎么说得专业？Feeling to Jargon 会识别需求所属领域，按需加载术语，把“有质感”“稳定”“高级”“专业一点”等模糊表达扩展成更具体、更可执行的提示词。 Feeling to Jargon 不替你决定方向。它把专业选项翻译成容易理解的语言，再让你选择真正重要的取舍。 | 你说 | Feeling to Jargon 帮你补全 | |---|---| | 做一个有质感的网站 | 信息密度、字体层级、对比度、留白节奏、组件一致性 | | 做一个稳定的大型后端 | 高可用、流量模型、水平扩展、幂等、熔断、可观测性 | | 做一个电影感的视频 | 景别、光线、构图、色调、运动、画幅比例、声音 | | 做一个高级感 Dashboard | 底色、强调色、布局层级、材质、内容主角 | ## 快速开始 推荐使用 `npx`，它适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、OpenCode 等 Agent 工具： ```bash npx skills add https://github.com/konglong87/feeling-to-jargon ``` 指定平台或只安装本 Skill： ```bash npx skills add https://github.com/konglong87/feeling-to-jargon --skill feeling-to-jargon --agent claude-code npx skills add https://github.com/konglong87/feeling-to-jargon --skill feeling-to-jargon --agent cursor npx skills add https://github.com/konglong87/feeling-to-jargon --skill feeling-to-jargon --agent codex npx skills add https://github.com/konglong87/feeling-to-jargon --skill feeling-to-jargon --agent opencode ``` 查看可用 Skill、全局安装： ```bash npx skills add https://github.com/konglong87/feeling-to-jargon --list npx skills add https://github.com/konglong87/feeling-to-jargon -g ``` 安装后可以直接说： ```text 删除列表项，5 秒内撤销并支持键盘；撤销时要沿原路径回来。 ``` ## 渐进式索引 > **索引越来越细，加载越来越少，术语越来越专，LLM 才能真正做到按需增强，而不是把整个知识库塞进上下文。** Feeling to Jargon 的运行路径固定为： ```text 根领域 → 专业子域 → 用户意图 → 叶子包 → 单条术语/技巧/模板 ``` ```mermaid flowchart LR A[用户模糊需求] --> B[index/root.json] B --> C[index/domains/domain.json] C --> D[index/intents/domain/subdomain.json] D --> E[index/runtime.json] E --> F[最小叶子包] F --> G[匹配的单条术语/模板] G --> H[增强提示词] ``` 根索引会声明加载上限： ```json { "max_subdomains": 3, "max_intents": 3, "max_intents_scope": "per_subdomain", "max_leaf_packages": 8, "max_entries_per_leaf": 30, "route_score_margin": 2, "high_confidence_score": 6, "high_confidence_margin": 1, "min_route_score": 2 } ``` 因此，一个“撤销条 + 键盘可用”的请求只会加载交互动效和可访问性相关叶子包，不会加载所有 UI、AIGC 或后端知识。 当前已建立： - 19 个根领域入口 - 105 个可独立加载的叶子包 - 5 级加载协议 - 7 种知识类型：术语、模式、技巧、规范、参数、模板、平台研究 - 非空运行时索引和本地查询器 ## 按需查询 在仓库根目录运行： ```bash python3 scripts/query-index.py "删除列表项，5 秒内撤销并支持键盘" python3 scripts/query-index.py "设计一个不模板化的 AI 数据后台" python3 scripts/query-index.py "把这个角色做成毛绒玩偶和周边" python3 scripts/query-index.py "GPUIX 能不能跑移动端？" ``` 查询结果会输出： - 命中的子域和叶子包 - 实际加载的文件路径 - 匹配的术语/技巧/模板条目 - `provider-specific` 和 `do_not_generalize` 等边界标记 - 本次是否触发网络搜索（默认不搜索） ## 内容分层 ### UI/UX 覆盖撤销条、FLIP 反向归位、跟随/阈值/吸附、速度继承、可中断动画、12 种基础动效、14 种连续交互和 10 种高级手势模式、Dashboard 视觉配方、5 种视觉效果、GSAP 适配边界、8 个可投喂给 AI 的组件描述，以及键盘、读屏和 `prefers-reduced-motion` 约束。 连续交互包把搜索框、FAB 面板、提交状态、图标变形、标签指示条、步进器、列表展开、FLIP 布局切换、滚动收起和全屏揭示拆成独立叶子；本轮新增勾选联动、叠卡展开、吸附卡加画线和圆形扩散转场，并把惯性滚轮归入高级手势交互。已有组件索引继续扩展为撕线弹出面板、保存按钮进度环和卡片层叠轮播；只有没有合适既有边界的吸边悬浮球新建叶子。每个模式都用状态机、动画序列、空间锚点、可测参数、可访问性和验收标准描述，把“细腻”“顺滑”“有质感”等感觉翻译成可以实现和检查的术语。高级手势包还覆盖按住确认、旋钮、前后对比、弧形菜单、滑动确认、长按预览、拖拽吸入、分段进度和透视轮播。 视觉效果包会把实现参数和性能边界一起加载：液态玻璃栏、封面取色氛围光、景深分层滚动、圆柱卷收列表、液滴粘连拖拽。每条记录同时提供性能预算、降级方案、移动端处理和减少动态策略，避免只复制视觉效果而忽略运行成本。 GSAP 适配包只在用户指定 GSAP 或项目已经使用 GSAP 时加载，覆盖 Core、Timeline、ScrollTrigger、Plugins、React 生命周期、性能和框架生命周期。它保留 provider-specific 与版本核验边界，不把工具 API 当作通用浏览器事实。 设计系统包提供 Light/Dark 活样式预览规范：色板、排印、按钮/输入框/卡片状态、token 到页面效果的映射和截图验收清单。外部预览站只作为待核验参考，不写入运行时事实。 ### AIGC 保留基础 IP 和七个场景模板，并将角色一致性、图像提示词、视频镜头、材质、构图、运动、负面约束和工具适配拆成独立子域。一次请求只读取需要的模块。 ### 后端与软件工程 将后端架构、高可用、高并发、扩展策略、可观测性、幂等、前端平台和跨平台渲染分开索引，避免把“稳定”“高并发”“高扩展”当成没有边界的口号。 ### 平台研究 GPUIX 和 ThreeUI 内容被标记为 `platform-research`、`provider-specific`。未填写 `verified_at` 前只能当作待核验研究线索，不能泛化成所有 GPU UI 框架的事实。 ## 项目结构 ```text index/ ├── root.json # 根领域与加载上限 ├── packages.json # 兼容旧版领域术语包入口 ├── domains/ # 第二级：专业子域 ├── intents/ # 第三级：用户意图 ├── leaves.json # 第四级：叶子包清单 └── runtime.json # 热路径运行时路由索引 terms/ ├── interaction/ # 动效、撤销、跟手、阈值、吸附 ├── dashboard/ # Dashboard 视觉方向 ├── component-design/ # AI 可生成组件描述 ├── visual-effects/ # 玻璃、光晕、景深和液态交互 ├── animation-tool-adapter/ # GSAP 等动画工具适配 ├── design-system/ # Light/Dark 活样式预览规范 ├── character-ip/ # AIGC 角色一致性 ├── platform-research/ # 平台专属研究 ├── software-engineering/ # 软件架构叶子包 └── workplace/ # 职场表达与协作 templates/ ├── aigc/ # 基础 IP 与七个场景模板 ├── dashboard/ # Dashboard 审美 Skill 模板 skills/feeling-to-jargon/SKILL.md # Agent 加载规则 scripts/query-index.py # 渐进式查询器 scripts/validate-index.py # 索引一致性校验 scripts/bootstrap-progressive-content.py # 可重复生成内容与索引 ``` ## Dashboard：三层规范，不增加索引 术语定义信息结构 → UI 定义视觉与栅格 → Agent 定义交互状态机。布局变体合并到现有 `layout-patterns` 叶子，共用 `templates/dashboard/dashboard-style-system.json`；不会为每种配色或业务场景创建新叶子。 | 同类条目 | 关键约束 | 来源状态 | | --- | --- | --- | | 多彩错列布局 | 日期只联动柱形与标签；容量圆点独立 | 原文已提供 | | 工业分区布局 | 低库存 `st=2`；物料选中联动补货卡；计数由集合派生 | 原文已提供 | | 中轴观测布局 | 队列、读数、星图和曲线共享目标与时间 | 原文已提供 | | 玻璃点阵布局 | 月份与指标共享状态；点 8 月评分回到 8 月 | 原文已提供 | | 暖色三栏布局 | 已知视觉可复用；房间点击、模式/单位映射待确认 | 执行描述不完整 | 具体查询先在叶子内部排序，再应用 `--max-entries` 限额；未指定变体时只返回概览。同分路由不再因为条目合并而降权。 每条提供 `layout / termSkill / uiSkill / agentExec / state / tokens`，并区分原文信息与建议的状态建模。第六例未提供原文，不生成虚构模板或空叶子；前五例的参数只在各自示例内有效。 ```bash python3 scripts/query-index.py "工业分区布局" --max-entries 1 python3 scripts/query-index.py "玻璃点阵月份指标联动" ``` ## 添加新领域骨架 SOP 1. 在 `index/root.json` 增加根领域和 `subdomain_index`。 2. 新建 `index/domains/.json`，只放子域摘要和加载入口。 3. 为每个子域新建 `index/intents//.json`，只放意图和叶子引用。 4. 在 `terms//` 增加独立叶子包；每个叶子只描述一个术语、模式、技巧或模板集合。 5. 在 `index/leaves.json` 登记叶子元数据，在 `index/runtime.json` 增加关键词路由。 6. 跑校验和端到端查询： ```bash python3 scripts/validate-index.py python3 scripts/test-progressive-index.py # 包含 Dashboard 合并分类、限载和幂等回归 python3 scripts/query-index.py "一个真实用户请求" ``` 7. 只提交公开、可复用、无密钥、无本机路径和无用户隐私的内容。 叶子 JSON 是可编辑的事实来源。运行 `scripts/bootstrap-progressive-content.py` 时，已有叶子会被读取并保留；只有缺失叶子会从内置骨架生成。确实需要用脚本内置内容覆盖已有叶子时，才显式使用： ```bash python3 scripts/bootstrap-progressive-content.py --force ``` 意图索引按 `index/intents//.json` 命名，避免不同领域出现同名子域时互相覆盖。 ## 卸载 ```bash npx skills list npx skills remove feeling-to-jargon npx skills remove feeling-to-jargon -g npx skills remove feeling-to-jargon --agent cursor ``` 若安装器参数发生变化，请以 `npx skills --help` 的当前提示为准。 ## #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create Feeling to Jargon progressive indexes and granular knowledge packages."""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
import argparse
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DASHBOARD_LAYOUT_LEAF_ID = "layout-patterns"
DASHBOARD_STYLE_TEMPLATE_PATH = "templates/dashboard/dashboard-style-system.json"

def normalize_keyword(value: str) -> str:
    return unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", value).casefold().strip()

PARSER = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Bootstrap or refresh Feeling to Jargon progressive indexes")
PARSER.add_argument(
    "--force",
    action="store_true",
    help="regenerate existing leaf JSON from the embedded bootstrap catalog",
)
ARGS = PARSER.parse_args()

def dump(path: str, data: dict) -> None:
    target = ROOT / path
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

def read_json(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return json.load(handle)

def adopt_existing_leaf(spec: dict) -> None:
    """Treat an existing leaf JSON as authored content unless --force is used."""
    target = ROOT / spec["path"]
    if not target.is_file() or ARGS.force is True:
        dump(spec["path"], {
            "schema_version": "1.0.0",
            **{key: value for key, value in spec.items() if key not in {"path", "entries"}},
            "entries": spec["entries"],
        })
        return
    existing = read_json(target)
    required = ("leaf_id", "domain_id", "subdomain_id", "title", "knowledge_type", "status", "intent_ids", "entries")
    missing = [key for key in required if key not in existing]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"leaf {spec['path']} is missing required fields: {', '.join(missing)}")
    existing["path"] = spec["path"]
    existing.setdefault("scope", "general")
    existing.setdefault("do_not_generalize", False)
    spec.clear()
    spec.update(existing)

def discover_authored_leaves() -> None:
    """Include manually added granular leaves in the next generated index."""
    for path in sorted((ROOT / "terms").rglob("*.json")):
        relative = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        if len(path.relative_to(ROOT / "terms").parts) == 1:
            continue
        data = read_json(path)
        leaf_id = data.get("leaf_id")
        if not leaf_id or leaf_id in leaf_defs:
            continue
        required = ("domain_id", "subdomain_id", "title", "knowledge_type", "status", "intent_ids", "entries")
        if all(key in data for key in required):
            data.setdefault("scope", "general")
            data.setdefault("do_not_generalize", False)
            leaf_defs[leaf_id] = {"path": relative, **data}

# Keep root/package indexes backward compatible while publishing the progressive loader policy.
root = json.loads((ROOT / "index/root.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
root["schema_version"] = "2.0.0"
root["loading_policy"] = {
    "strategy": "progressive",
    "levels": ["root", "subdomain", "intent", "leaf", "entry"],
    "max_subdomains": 3,
    "max_intents": 3,
    "max_intents_scope": "per_subdomain",
    "max_leaf_packages": 8,
    "max_entries_per_leaf": 30,
    "route_score_margin": 2,
    "high_confidence_score": 6,

    "search_fallback": "ask-before-network",
}
domain_specs = {

# Small generic subdomain skeletons keep all roots progressively addressable without pretending coverage.

for domain in root["domains"]:

    domain["loading_hint"] = "先匹配子域，再读取最小叶子包"

def add_leaf(path, leaf_id, domain_id, subdomain_id, title, knowledge_type, entries, intent_ids=None, scope="general", extra=None):
    leaf_defs[leaf_id] = {
        "path": path,
        "leaf_id": leaf_id,
        "domain_id": domain_id,
        "subdomain_id": subdomain_id,
        "title": title,
        "knowledge_type": knowledge_type,
        "scope": scope,
        "status": "published",
        "intent_ids": intent_ids or [],
        "entries": entries,
        **(extra or {}),
    }

# Shared helpers.
def entry(eid, name, plain, when, params=None, related=None, constraints=None, aliases=None, **extra):
    result = {
        "id": eid, "name": name, "plain_language": plain, "when_to_use": when,
        "parameters": params or [], "related": related or [], "constraints": constraints or [], "aliases": aliases or []
    }
    result.update(extra)
    return result

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E2E regression checks for consolidated Dashboard knowledge and entry budgets."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

# Import the CLI for pure ranking checks without leaving bytecode artifacts.
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LAYOUT_LEAF_ID = "layout-patterns"
LAYOUT_PATH = "terms/dashboard/layout-patterns.json"
TEMPLATE_PATH = "templates/dashboard/dashboard-style-system.json"
FIELDS = {"layout", "termSkill", "uiSkill", "agentExec", "state", "tokens"}
EXPECTED_PATTERNS = {
    "多彩错列布局": "color-staggered-dashboard",
    "工业分区布局": "industrial-zones-dashboard",
    "中轴观测布局": "axial-observatory-dashboard",
    "玻璃点阵布局": "glass-dot-matrix-dashboard",
    "暖色三栏布局": "warm-three-column-dashboard",
}
NATURAL_QUERIES = {
    "非对称双列，容量圆点独立切换": "color-staggered-dashboard",
    "低库存筛选并选中物料联动补货卡": "industrial-zones-dashboard",
    "共享选中态与时间轴预览联动": "axial-observatory-dashboard",
    "点阵读数和月份指标联动": "glass-dot-matrix-dashboard",
    "卧室房间联动和模式单位同步": "warm-three-column-dashboard",
}


def load(path):
    return json.loads((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def query(text, *options):
    result = subprocess.check_output(
        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "scripts/query-index.py"), text, *options], text=True,
    )
    return json.loads(result)


def json_snapshot(root):
    return {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in root.rglob("*.json")}


class DashboardPatternsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.leaf = load(LAYOUT_PATH)
        cls.template = load(TEMPLATE_PATH)
        cls.entries = {item["id"]: item for item in cls.leaf["entries"]}
        cls.patterns = {key: cls.entries[key] for key in EXPECTED_PATTERNS.values()}
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("query_index", ROOT / "scripts/query-index.py")
        cls.runtime = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(cls.runtime)

    def test_variants_share_one_leaf_and_one_route(self):
        ids = set(EXPECTED_PATTERNS.values())
        leaves = load("index/leaves.json")["leaves"]
        routes = load("index/runtime.json")["routes"]
        self.assertTrue(ids.isdisjoint(item["leaf_id"] for item in leaves))
        self.assertEqual(sum(item["leaf_id"] == LAYOUT_LEAF_ID for item in routes), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.leaf["default_entry_id"], LAYOUT_LEAF_ID)
        refs = self.template["pattern_refs"]
        self.assertEqual({ref["entry_id"] for ref in refs}, set(self.patterns))
        self.assertEqual(len(refs), len(self.patterns))
        for ref in refs:
            self.assertEqual(ref["path"], LAYOUT_PATH)
            self.assertEqual(ref["status"], self.entries[ref["entry_id"]]["evidence"]["status"])

    def test_titles_ids_and_natural_queries_are_reachable_under_budget(self):
        queries = {**EXPECTED_PATTERNS, **NATURAL_QUERIES,
                   **{key: key for key in EXPECTED_PATTERNS.values()}}
        for text, expected in queries.items():
            for options in [(), ("--max-entries", "1", "--max-leaves", "1")]:
                with self.subTest(query=text, options=options):
                    result = query(text, *options)
                    self.assertEqual(result["matches"][0]["leaf_id"], LAYOUT_LEAF_ID)
                    self.assertEqual([entry["id"] for entry in result["matches"][0]["entries"]], [expected])
                    self.assertLessEqual(result["trace"]["loaded_leaf_count"], 2)
                    self.assertEqual(result["network_search"], "not_requested")

    def test_shared_contract_and_state_references(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(self.template["field_contract"]), FIELDS)
        for item in self.patterns.values():
            with self.subTest(entry=item["id"]):
                self.assertTrue(FIELDS.issubset(item))
                self.assertEqual(item["contract_ref"], TEMPLATE_PATH)
                self.assertEqual(item["tokens"]["scope"], "provided_example")
                self.assertEqual(item["state"]["model_status"], "proposed_implementation")
                self.assertTrue(item["state"]["invariants"])
                state = item["state"]
                source = set(state["source"])
                derived = set(state["derived"])
                self.assertTrue(source.isdisjoint(derived))
                for action in item["agentExec"]:
                    writes = set(action.get("writes", []))
                    preserves = set(action.get("preserves", []))
                    self.assertTrue(writes <= source)
                    self.assertTrue(preserves <= source | derived)
                    self.assertTrue(writes.isdisjoint(preserves))
                    self.assertTrue(set(action.get("updates", [])) <= source | derived)

    def test_original_parameters_and_independent_state_are_preserved(self):
        color = self.patterns["color-staggered-dashboard"]
        self.assertEqual(color["tokens"]["values"]["grid_ratio"], [1.42, 1])
        self.assertEqual(color["tokens"]["values"]["radius_px"], 26)
        self.assertEqual(color["agentExec"][0]["preserves"], ["capacitySelection"])
        industrial = self.patterns["industrial-zones-dashboard"]
        self.assertEqual(industrial["agentExec"][0]["sets"], {"stockFilter": 2})
        self.assertEqual(industrial["agentExec"][2]["example_transition"], {"before": 7, "after": 8})
        self.assertEqual(industrial["state"]["derived"]["replenishmentCount"], "count(replenishmentItems)")
        observatory = self.patterns["axial-observatory-dashboard"]
        self.assertEqual(set(observatory["agentExec"][1]["updates"]), {"queueSelection", "readings", "starMap", "curve"})
        glass = self.patterns["glass-dot-matrix-dashboard"]
        self.assertEqual(glass["agentExec"][1]["example_values"], {"selectedMonth": 8, "selectedMetric": "score"})
        self.assertEqual(glass["agentExec"][2]["preserves"], ["selectedMonth"])

    def test_unconfirmed_execution_is_not_presented_as_complete(self):
        warm = self.patterns["warm-three-column-dashboard"]
        self.assertEqual(warm["evidence"]["status"], "needs_confirmation")
        self.assertEqual(warm["evidence"]["confirmed_layers"], ["layout", "termSkill", "uiSkill"])
        self.assertTrue(warm["evidence"]["missing_inputs"])
        for action in warm["agentExec"]:
            self.assertEqual(action["status"], "needs_confirmation")
        gaps = {item["slot"]: item for item in self.template["source_gaps"]}
        self.assertEqual(gaps[5]["status"], "needs_confirmation")
        self.assertEqual(gaps[6]["status"], "missing")
        self.assertNotIn("entry_id", gaps[6])
        self.assertEqual(len(self.patterns), 5)

    def test_entry_ranking_precedes_limit_and_preserves_legacy_fallback(self):
        entries = [{"id": "overview", "name": "概览"}, {"id": "target", "name": "工业分区布局"}]
        selected = self.runtime.select_entries("工业分区布局", entries, 1, 2)
        self.assertEqual(selected, [entries[1]])
        self.assertEqual(self.runtime.select_entries("unmatched", entries, 2, 2), entries)
        self.assertEqual(self.runtime.select_entries("unmatched", entries, 2, 2, "overview"), [entries[0]])
        self.assertEqual(self.runtime.select_entries("unmatched", [], 1, 2), [])

    def test_generic_query_uses_overview_without_dumping_variants(self):
        result = query("设计一个不模板化的 AI 数据后台")
        layout = next(item for item in result["matches"] if item["leaf_id"] == LAYOUT_LEAF_ID)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in layout["entries"]], [LAYOUT_LEAF_ID])
        self.assertIn("minimal-data", [item["leaf_id"] for item in result["matches"]])

    def test_combined_request_keeps_both_named_variants(self):
        result = query("比较工业分区布局与暖色三栏布局", "--max-entries", "2")
        layout = next(item for item in result["matches"] if item["leaf_id"] == LAYOUT_LEAF_ID)
        self.assertEqual({item["id"] for item in layout["entries"]},
                         {"industrial-zones-dashboard", "warm-three-column-dashboard"})

    def test_unrelated_queries_do_not_load_dashboard_family(self):
        for text in ["普通卡片轮播", "保存按钮变进度环", "GSAP timeline", "hello world"]:
            with self.subTest(query=text):
                result = query(text)
                self.assertNotIn(LAYOUT_LEAF_ID, [item["leaf_id"] for item in result["matches"]])

    def test_regeneration_keeps_authored_content_and_is_idempotent(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dashboard-regression-") as folder:
            target = Path(folder)
            for name in ("scripts", "terms", "templates", "index"):
                shutil.copytree(ROOT / name, target / name, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
            authored = target / LAYOUT_PATH
            document = json.loads(authored.read_text())
            document["entries"][-1]["aliases"].append("专属三栏回归别名")
            authored.write_text(json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            original = authored.read_bytes()
            command = [sys.executable, str(target / "scripts/bootstrap-progressive-content.py")]
            subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True)
            first = json_snapshot(target)
            subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual(first, json_snapshot(target))
            self.assertEqual(original, authored.read_bytes())
            self.assertEqual(len(json.loads((target / "index/leaves.json").read_text())["leaves"]),
                             len(load("index/leaves.json")["leaves"]))
            template = json.loads((target / TEMPLATE_PATH).read_text())
            self.assertEqual({item["entry_id"] for item in template["pattern_refs"]}, set(self.patterns))
            result = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
                [sys.executable, str(target / "scripts/query-index.py"), "专属三栏回归别名", "--max-entries", "1"], text=True))
            self.assertEqual(result["matches"][0]["entries"][0]["id"], "warm-three-column-dashboard")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

raw = subprocess.check_output(["python3", str(QUERY), "GPUIX 能不能跑移动端？"], text=True)

assert gpui_mobile["scope"] == "provider-specific", "provider scope was lost"

for option in ("--max-leaves", "--max-entries"):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate legacy and progressive Feeling to Jargon indexes without loading the whole knowledge corpus."""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def load(path: Path):
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

def assert_file(rel: str) -> dict:
    path = ROOT / rel
    assert path.is_file(), f"missing file: {rel}"
    return load(path)

root_doc = assert_file("index/root.json")
package_doc = assert_file("index/packages.json")
root = root_doc["domains"]
packages = package_doc["packages"]
root_ids = [item["domain_id"] for item in root]
package_ids = [item["domain_id"] for item in packages]
assert len(root_ids) == len(set(root_ids)), "duplicate root domain_id"
assert len([item["package_id"] for item in packages]) == len(set(item["package_id"] for item in packages)), "duplicate package_id"
assert set(root_ids) == set(package_ids), f"domain mismatch: roots={set(root_ids)-set(package_ids)}, packages={set(package_ids)-set(root_ids)}"
policy = root_doc["loading_policy"]
for key in ("max_subdomains", "max_intents", "max_leaf_packages", "max_entries_per_leaf", "route_score_margin", "high_confidence_score", "high_confidence_margin", "min_route_score"):
    assert isinstance(policy[key], int) and policy[key] > 0, f"invalid loading limit: {key}"
assert policy.get("max_intents_scope") == "per_subdomain", "intent limit scope must be per_subdomain"
for item in packages:
    term_path = ROOT / item["term_path"]
    assert term_path.is_file(), f"missing legacy term package: {item['term_path']}"
    term = load(term_path)
    assert term["package_id"] == item["package_id"], f"package id mismatch: {item['package_id']}"
    assert term["domain_id"] == item["domain_id"], f"domain id mismatch: {item['package_id']}"
    assert term["status"] == item["status"], f"status mismatch: {item['package_id']}"
    intent_ids = {intent["id"] for intent in term.get("intents", [])}
    assert set(item["intents"]) == intent_ids, f"intent mismatch: {item['package_id']}"

leaves_doc = assert_file("index/leaves.json")
runtime_doc = assert_file("index/runtime.json")
leaves = leaves_doc["leaves"]
routes = runtime_doc["routes"]
leaf_ids = [item["leaf_id"] for item in leaves]
assert leaf_ids and len(leaf_ids) == len(set(leaf_ids)), "duplicate or empty leaf_id"
assert len(routes) == len(leaf_ids), "runtime route count mismatch"
route_ids = {item["leaf_id"] for item in routes}
assert route_ids == set(leaf_ids), "runtime routes and leaf manifest differ"
leaf_by_id = {item["leaf_id"]: item for item in leaves}
intent_ids_by_subdomain = {}
intent_index_paths = set()
for domain in root:
    domain_doc = assert_file(domain["subdomain_index"])
    assert domain_doc["domain_id"] == domain["domain_id"], f"domain index mismatch: {domain['domain_id']}"
    subdomain_ids = {item["subdomain_id"] for item in domain_doc["subdomains"]}
    assert subdomain_ids, f"empty subdomain index: {domain['domain_id']}"
    for subdomain in domain_doc["subdomains"]:
        assert subdomain["intent_index"] not in intent_index_paths, f"duplicate intent index path: {subdomain['intent_index']}"
        intent_index_paths.add(subdomain["intent_index"])
        intent_doc = assert_file(subdomain["intent_index"])
        assert intent_doc["subdomain_id"] == subdomain["subdomain_id"], f"intent index mismatch: {subdomain['subdomain_id']}"
        assert intent_doc.get("domain_id") == domain["domain_id"], f"intent domain mismatch: {subdomain['subdomain_id']}"
        intent_ids_by_subdomain[(domain["domain_id"], subdomain["subdomain_id"])] = {
            intent["id"] for intent in intent_doc.get("intents", [])
        }
        intent_leaf_refs = {
            leaf_id
            for intent in intent_doc.get("intents", [])
            for leaf_id in intent.get("leaf_refs", [])
        }
        expected_leaf_refs = {
            leaf["leaf_id"]
            for leaf in leaves
            if leaf["domain_id"] == domain["domain_id"] and leaf["subdomain_id"] == subdomain["subdomain_id"]
        }
        assert intent_leaf_refs == expected_leaf_refs, f"intent leaf mismatch: {subdomain['subdomain_id']}"
for leaf in leaves:
    leaf_doc = assert_file(leaf["path"])
    assert leaf_doc["leaf_id"] == leaf["leaf_id"], f"leaf id mismatch: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
    assert leaf_doc["domain_id"] == leaf["domain_id"], f"leaf domain mismatch: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
    assert leaf_doc["subdomain_id"] == leaf["subdomain_id"], f"leaf subdomain mismatch: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
    assert leaf_doc["status"] == leaf["status"], f"leaf status mismatch: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
    assert leaf_doc["knowledge_type"] == leaf["knowledge_type"], f"knowledge type mismatch: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
    assert len(leaf_doc.get("entries", [])) == leaf["entry_count"], f"entry count mismatch: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
    entry_ids = [item["id"] for item in leaf_doc.get("entries", [])]
    assert len(entry_ids) == len(set(entry_ids)), f"duplicate entry id: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
    if leaf_doc.get("default_entry_id"):
        assert leaf_doc["default_entry_id"] in entry_ids, f"missing overview entry: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
    if leaf["scope"] == "provider-specific":
        assert leaf_doc.get("do_not_generalize") is True, f"provider leaf must be scoped: {leaf['leaf_id']}"
for route in routes:
    normalized_keywords = [unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", keyword).casefold().strip() for keyword in route["keywords"]]
    assert len(normalized_keywords) == len(set(normalized_keywords)), f"duplicate route keywords: {route['leaf_id']}"
    manifest = leaf_by_id[route["leaf_id"]]
    for field in ("title", "path", "domain_id", "subdomain_id", "knowledge_type", "entry_count", "scope", "intent_ids", "do_not_generalize", "provider"):
        assert route.get(field) == manifest.get(field), f"runtime metadata mismatch: {route['leaf_id']} field={field}"
    route_intents = set(route.get("intent_ids", []))
    known_intents = intent_ids_by_subdomain[(route["domain_id"], route["subdomain_id"])]
    assert route_intents <= known_intents, f"runtime intent mismatch: {route['leaf_id']}"
    assert route["keywords"], f"empty runtime keywords: {route['leaf_id']}"
print(f"index ok: {len(root)} domains, {len(packages)} legacy packages, {len(leaves)} progressive leaves, {len(routes)} runtime routes")

---
name: feeling-to-jargon
description: 将用户的感觉和模糊表达翻译成专业术语，并按需补全为更具体、可执行的提示词。
---

# Feeling to Jargon

Feeling to Jargon 帮助用户把模糊感受翻译成专业术语，再按需补全成可执行的提示词。

## 渐进式加载协议

索引必须按以下顺序逐级收窄：

```text
根领域 → 专业子域 → 用户意图 → 叶子包 → 单条术语/技巧/模板
```

1. 读取 `index/root.json`，只判断候选根领域和加载上限。
2. 读取对应的 `index/domains/<domain_id>.json`，最多选择 `max_subdomains` 个子域。
3. 读取子域的 `index/intents/<domain_id>/<subdomain_id>.json`，最多选择 `max_intents` 个意图。
4. 读取 `index/runtime.json` 做关键词/语义路由，只加载命中的叶子路径；低于 `min_route_score` 的弱匹配直接丢弃，高置信度匹配使用更窄的分数差裁剪。
5. 每个叶子最多取 `max_entries_per_leaf` 条，优先取与用户表达最接近的条目。复杂交互优先读取同一叶子中的 `state_machine`、阈值、取消路径和 `acceptance`，不要只拿一段视觉描述。
6. 用语义匹配识别术语、同义词、相关维度和缺失参数。
7. 把匹配结果翻译成用户能看懂的解释，输出 3～6 个可执行方向。
8. 只询问会改变方案的问题；用户确认后再生成最终增强提示词。

运行时查询示例：

```bash
python3 scripts/query-index.py "删除列表项，5 秒内撤销并支持键盘"
```

不要直接读取 `terms/` 全目录，也不要把所有叶子包一次性塞进上下文。没有命中时，先说明覆盖不足；只有用户允许时才进行网络搜索。

## 知识类型

叶子包用 `knowledge_type` 区分：

- `term`：专业术语和白话解释
- `pattern`：可复用的设计/架构模式
- `technique`：实现技巧和参数锚点
- `guideline`：可访问性、质量和边界规范
- `parameter`：设计或运行参数
- `template`：可直接投喂给 AI 的提示词模板
- `platform-research`：平台专属研究，必须标注范围和核验状态

没有匹配到术语包时，说明覆盖不足；只有在用户允许时才进行网络搜索。搜索结果是本次临时参考，不写回术语列表。

## Dashboard 三层规范（合并分类）

Dashboard 布局变体优先放进已有 `terms/dashboard/layout-patterns.json` 的条目，不为每个配色、场景或布局再建索引叶子。命中后只取当前条目，再按 `contract_ref` 读取 `templates/dashboard/dashboard-style-system.json` 的共享协议；视觉方向复用已有相关叶子，仅在需要时加载，不展开全部变体。

按 `layout / termSkill / uiSkill / agentExec / state / tokens` 输出：术语定义信息结构，UI 定义视觉与栅格，Agent 定义交互状态机。分清共享状态与独立状态，写清每个事件改变什么、不改变什么，以及派生视图和验收断言。示例配色、比例和像素值不是全局默认值。

先检查条目 `evidence` 与模板 `source_gaps`。暖色三栏的执行逻辑仍待确认，可以使用已知布局，但不能把候选房间联动或模式/单位映射当作事实；第六例没有原文，不补造、不建空索引。不要求用户重复确认前四例。

## AIGC IP 模板

当请求涉及同一角色的多种材质、动作、表情或周边时，先读取 `templates/aigc/base-ip.json`，再按场景读取一个 `templates/aigc/*.json`。合并基础 IP、一致性约束、场景模块和目标工具参数；不要把七个场景全部加载到同一次请求中。中文文字建议预留排版区域，由后期工具叠加。

`terms/character-ip/character-ip.json` 只负责角色一致性和场景路由；镜头、构图、运动、负面约束和工具适配分别从对应子域加载。

## 交互、视觉效果与工具适配

连续交互和高级手势一次只加载一个模式。先读状态机、动画序列、触发阈值、空间锚点和取消/回退路径，再读可测参数、可访问性和验收标准；不要把整组交互一次性塞入上下文。遇到“细腻”“顺滑”“有质感”等感觉时，优先输出可观察的时间、速度、位移、旋转、缩放、吸附和先后关系。默认要求动画可中断、键盘和触摸结果一致，并遵守 `prefers-reduced-motion`。

视觉效果必须和性能一起加载。液态玻璃、景深、圆柱卷收、取色光晕和液态粘连都要同时读取 `performance_budget`、`fallback`、`mobile_degradation` 和 `reduced_motion` 字段；如果设备能力不足，先降级表现再保证主任务可用。

GSAP 适配只在用户明确指定 GSAP，或项目已经依赖 GSAP 时加载。优先使用工具对应叶子的生命周期、SSR 边界、`ctx.revert()`/销毁规则和 transform 性能约束；未指定 GSAP 时不要主动引入它。

设计系统预览优先加载 `living-style-guide-preview`，用 Light/Dark、token、组件状态和视觉验收清单指导实现。外部预览站、厂商文档和示例仓库必须保留 `verification_required`，未核验时只能作为参考线索。

## 平台研究边界

`platform-research` 叶子包只记录指定供应商或项目的研究信息。若 `verified_at` 为空，必须把内容说成待核验信息，不得推广为所有 GPU UI 框架或所有平台的通用事实。

{
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "template_id": "dashboard-style-system",
  "name": "Dashboard 审美 Skill",
  "type": "template",
  "inputs": [
    "product_or_scene",
    "style_direction",
    "content_priority"
  ],
  "style_directions": [
    {
      "id": "warm-minimal",
      "name": "暖调留白型",
      "rule": "奶油底色、单一黄色强调、细边框和弱阴影，保留呼吸感。",
      "tokens": [
        "#F7F3EA",
        "一个主强调色",
        "圆角克制",
        "弱阴影"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "high-contrast",
      "name": "强对比视觉型",
      "rule": "一张主卡占据视觉中心，用高饱和对比和大数字建立层级。",
      "tokens": [
        "主卡占视觉中心",
        "硬阴影",
        "大数字",
        "非对称"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "minimal-data",
      "name": "极简数据型",
      "rule": "以灰阶和一个强调色组织数据，去网格线和多余标签。",
      "tokens": [
        "灰阶为主",
        "胶囊柱状图",
        "标签精简"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "immersive-atmosphere",
      "name": "氛围沉浸型",
      "rule": "深色底、雾面渐变、玻璃卡片和轻微动态光斑。",
      "tokens": [
        "GPU 负载预算",
        "移动端降级",
        "模糊光斑"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "image-led-content",
      "name": "图卡内容型",
      "rule": "让真实图片成为主角，文字叠加且只保留一个强调色。",
      "tokens": [
        "大图卡片",
        "文字叠加",
        "单一 CTA 色"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "layout-patterns",
      "name": "高级布局模式",
      "rule": "用错位、大图、非对称、层叠、留白和破格出血建立布局性格。",
      "tokens": [
        "错位按 8/12/16px 节奏",
        "7:3 或 8:2 比例",
        "只破一处网格",
        "安全区内留信息"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "grid-glass-dashboard",
      "name": "方格纸玻璃卡 Dashboard",
      "rule": "用 44px 方格纸做底，让半透明白玻璃卡透出底层网格，指标按数值形成阶梯。",
      "tokens": [
        "44px 网格底",
        "半透明白玻璃",
        "指标阶梯排列",
        "实心/斜纹/渐变填充"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "grouped-sidebar-dashboard",
      "name": "分组侧边栏 Dashboard",
      "rule": "把导航拆成三组并用大留白分隔，主区用超大细体字、三组数字和横向比例条建立节奏。",
      "tokens": [
        "三组导航",
        "10px 大写灰字组名",
        "底部头像/用量条",
        "横向比例条替代饼图"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "single-dark-accent-dashboard",
      "name": "单深色单强调色 Dashboard",
      "rule": "整页只保留一条深色侧边栏和一个强调色，当前项、主按钮和命中图表共享同一强调色。",
      "tokens": [
        "唯一深色侧边栏",
        "单一强调色",
        "侧栏底部强调色卡片",
        "其余区域保持浅色"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "tonal-dark-dashboard",
      "name": "暗底明度分层 Dashboard",
      "rule": "近黑底上只用明度区分卡片层级，不画描边；主读数放大，日期用圆点阵列表达。",
      "tokens": [
        "近黑底",
        "卡片亮一档",
        "无描边",
        "超大主读数",
        "圆点阵列+斜纹空格"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "output_contract": [
    "页面结构",
    "色彩规范",
    "组件规范",
    "可直接给 AI 的提示词"
  ],
  "field_contract": {
    "layout": "布局名称与信息结构；不新增同义叶子",
    "termSkill": "专业术语与结构关系；引用现有分类",
    "uiSkill": "视觉层级、栅格、材质、排版；不负责修改业务状态",
    "agentExec": "事件、前置条件、写入状态、派生视图与不受影响的状态",
    "state": "唯一事实源、派生关系、不变量；新增实现建议需明确标记",
    "tokens": "明确单位与适用范围；用户示例值不是全局默认值"
  },
  "shared_execution_contract": {
    "flow": [
      "事件",
      "校验/前置条件",
      "一次状态转换",
      "派生所有关联视图",
      "验收"
    ],
    "rules": [
      "共享的是选择 ID 与时间上下文，不是每个面板各自复制一份状态；独立控件不得误联动。",
      "展示读数由状态派生；请求失败、空数据与快速连续切换不得留下混合视图，异步结果需校验当前上下文。",
      "颜色/尺寸是当前示例的 token，不是行为触发条件；计数从集合派生，不写死 7→8。",
      "键盘与指针操作保持同样状态结果；选中/加载/错误不能只靠颜色，动态效果提供减少动态路径。",
      "固定栏不等于固定整个页面；窄屏策略与断点未提供时先标记建议，不臆造原稿数值。"
    ],
    "acceptance": [
      "事件前/后真实截图覆盖受影响与不受影响区域",
      "端到端验证状态联动、独立性、错误/快速切换与键盘路径",
      "截图只验证可见结果，状态一致性同时用断言验证"
    ]
  },
  "source_gaps": [
    {
      "slot": 5,
      "status": "needs_confirmation",
      "entry_id": "warm-three-column-dashboard",
      "missing": "完整点击逻辑、模式与单位映射；候选执行逻辑不得默认落地"
    },
    {
      "slot": 6,
      "status": "missing",
      "missing": "第六个 Dashboard 的三层提示词原文",
      "policy": "不创建空叶子、不生成虚构案例，不声称六例完整"
    }
  ],
  "pattern_refs": [
    {
      "entry_id": "color-staggered-dashboard",
      "path": "terms/dashboard/layout-patterns.json",
      "status": "provided"
    },
    {
      "entry_id": "industrial-zones-dashboard",
      "path": "terms/dashboard/layout-patterns.json",
      "status": "provided"
    },
    {
      "entry_id": "axial-observatory-dashboard",
      "path": "terms/dashboard/layout-patterns.json",
      "status": "provided"
    },
    {
      "entry_id": "glass-dot-matrix-dashboard",
      "path": "terms/dashboard/layout-patterns.json",
      "status": "provided"
    },
    {
      "entry_id": "warm-three-column-dashboard",
      "path": "terms/dashboard/layout-patterns.json",
      "status": "needs_confirmation"
    }
  ],
  "forbidden_defaults": [
    "默认蓝紫渐变",
    "所有卡片一样大",
    "满屏圆角矩形",
    "过多颜色和图标",
    "模板化侧边栏+顶栏+四张 KPI 卡"
  ]
}

{
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "package_id": "aigc-core",
  "domain_id": "ai-aigc-meta-skills",
  "title": "AIGC 影像与提示词需求澄清术语包",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "status": "published",
  "intents": [
    {
      "id": "generate-image",
      "action": "生成",
      "object": "图像"
    },
    {
      "id": "generate-video",
      "action": "生成",
      "object": "视频"
    },
    {
      "id": "write-prompt",
      "action": "编写",
      "object": "AIGC 提示词"
    }
  ],
  "dimensions": [
    {
      "id": "subject",
      "name": "主体描述",
      "definition": "画面里具体出现什么对象或人物。",
      "value_type": "free_text"
    },
    {
      "id": "shot",
      "name": "景别与镜头",
      "definition": "画面框到主体哪里，以及视野宽窄。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "lighting",
      "name": "光线",
      "definition": "光从哪里来、软硬和明暗关系。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "composition",
      "name": "构图",
      "definition": "主体在画面中的位置和视觉平衡。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "color",
      "name": "色调",
      "definition": "画面整体偏暖、偏冷、鲜艳或克制。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "motion",
      "name": "运动与运镜",
      "definition": "主体怎么动、镜头怎么移动以及速度幅度。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "sound",
      "name": "声音",
      "definition": "人声、环境音和背景音乐的组成。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "style",
      "name": "视觉风格",
      "definition": "材质、媒介或影像风格的方向。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "aspect_ratio",
      "name": "画幅比例",
      "definition": "横屏、竖屏、方形或宽银幕比例。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    }
  ],
  "terms": [
    {
      "id": "shot-close",
      "term": "特写",
      "plain_language": "只拍脸或一个物件细节。",
      "benefit": "突出表情或关键细节。",
      "cost": "环境信息会减少。",
      "dimension_id": "shot"
    },
    {
      "id": "shot-medium",
      "term": "中景",
      "plain_language": "通常拍到膝盖以上并保留部分环境。",
      "benefit": "人物和场景信息较平衡。",
      "cost": "细节冲击弱于特写。",
      "dimension_id": "shot"
    },
    {
      "id": "shot-wide",
      "term": "全景",
      "plain_language": "拍到完整人物和环境。",
      "benefit": "交代空间关系清楚。",
      "cost": "人物细节更少。",
      "dimension_id": "shot"
    },
    {
      "id": "light-soft",
      "term": "柔光",
      "plain_language": "阴影边缘柔和，画面更平顺。",
      "benefit": "适合人像和温和氛围。",
      "cost": "戏剧冲突较弱。",
      "dimension_id": "lighting"
    },
    {
      "id": "light-hard",
      "term": "硬光",
      "plain_language": "阴影边缘锐利，明暗反差强。",
      "benefit": "画面更有戏剧性。",
      "cost": "容易显得生硬。",
      "dimension_id": "lighting"
    },
    {
      "id": "comp-center",
      "term": "中心构图",
      "plain_language": "主体放在画面正中。",
      "benefit": "稳定、直接、容易理解。",
      "cost": "画面变化和动势较少。",
      "dimension_id": "composition"
    },
    {
      "id": "color-warm",
      "term": "暖色调",
      "plain_language": "整体偏橙黄，感觉温暖。",
      "benefit": "适合怀旧、亲近和日落氛围。",
      "cost": "冷静疏离感较弱。",
      "dimension_id": "color"
    },
    {
      "id": "motion-static",
      "term": "固定镜头",
      "plain_language": "相机保持不动，主要看主体动作。",
      "benefit": "画面稳定，便于观察。",
      "cost": "动态冲击较少。",
      "dimension_id": "motion"
    },
    {
      "id": "motion-follow",
      "term": "跟随运镜",
      "plain_language": "镜头跟着主体移动。",
      "benefit": "运动关系更强，沉浸感更高。",
      "cost": "生成稳定性和构图控制要求更高。",
      "dimension_id": "motion"
    },
    {
      "id": "style-film",
      "term": "电影感影像",
      "plain_language": "通过光线、构图、色调和景深形成统一影像风格。",
      "benefit": "整体气质更明确。",
      "cost": "不能保证自动达到某部电影的具体效果。",
      "dimension_id": "style"
    },
    {
      "id": "ratio-landscape",
      "term": "16:9 横屏",
      "plain_language": "适合常规横屏视频和网页展示。",
      "benefit": "横向空间充足。",
      "cost": "手机竖屏展示需要裁切。",
      "dimension_id": "aspect_ratio"
    },
    {
      "id": "ratio-portrait",
      "term": "9:16 竖屏",
      "plain_language": "适合短视频和手机全屏观看。",
      "benefit": "移动端占屏更充分。",
      "cost": "横向场景信息更受限。",
      "dimension_id": "aspect_ratio"
    }
  ],
  "mappings": [
    {
      "expression": "电影感",
      "level": "L3",
      "intent_ids": [
        "generate-image",
        "generate-video",
        "write-prompt"
      ],
      "dimension_ids": [
        "shot",
        "lighting",
        "composition",
        "color",
        "style"
      ],
      "reason": "需要拆解镜头、光线、构图、色调和风格。"
    }
  ],
  "template_refs": {
    "base_ip": "templates/aigc/base-ip.json",
    "scenes": [
      "templates/aigc/lineart-to-3d.json",
      "templates/aigc/plush-texture.json",
      "templates/aigc/turnaround-3view.json",
      "templates/aigc/expression-sheet.json",
      "templates/aigc/action-sheet.json",
      "templates/aigc/outfit-sheet.json",
      "templates/aigc/merchandise-set.json"
    ]
  }
}

files.terms/backend.json:
{
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "package_id": "backend-core",
  "domain_id": "software-engineering-architecture",
  "title": "后端与软件工程需求澄清术语包（幂等子域草案）",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "status": "published",
  "intents": [
    {
      "id": "design-write",
      "action": "设计",
      "object": "非支付写入 API 的重复处理契约"
    },
    {
      "id": "diagnose-write",
      "action": "排查",
      "object": "重复写入或响应不明的现象"
    }
  ],
  "dimensions": [
    {
      "id": "identity",
      "name": "操作身份",
      "definition": "约定哪一笔操作算同一笔；识别范围包括调用方或租户以及操作种类，不能仅由内容相同推断。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "retry",
      "name": "结果不明时的重试策略",
      "definition": "规定结果不明时是按已支持的契约复用请求身份，还是暂停自动提交并核实。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "payload",
      "name": "同身份内容变化规则",
      "definition": "同一操作身份再次出现时，如何处理影响业务意图的内容变化。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "concurrency",
      "name": "处理中重复请求的响应方式",
      "definition": "首个同身份操作尚未完成时，重复到达者得到处理中状态还是明确拒绝。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "retention",
      "name": "重复识别记录保留窗口",
      "definition": "从明确约定的起点保留操作识别记录的时长，以 h 表示；到期与清理行为需另述。",
      "value_type": "continuous"
    },
    {
      "id": "protection",
      "name": "结果与写入记录保护",
      "definition": "为重复请求记录可关联的结果，并要求识别记录和业务变更在声明边界内一致生效。",
      "value_type": "multi_select"
    },
    {
      "id": "symptom",
      "name": "可观察的写入现象",
      "definition": "记录时间线、请求身份是否相同、响应及可见写入结果；只保留观察，不把超时判断为失败。",
      "value_type": "free_text"
    },
    {
      "id": "availability",
      "name": "高可用目标",
      "definition": "系统在故障、发布或依赖异常时继续提供服务的目标与边界。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "capacity",
      "name": "并发与流量模型",
      "definition": "明确并发用户、请求速率、峰值、突发和延迟目标。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "scalability",
      "name": "扩展策略",
      "definition": "明确通过加机器、分片、缓存或异步化应对增长的方式。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "resilience",
      "name": "容错与降级",
      "definition": "明确超时、重试、熔断、限流和降级的组合。",
      "value_type": "multi_select"
    },
    {
      "id": "observability",
      "name": "可观测性",
      "definition": "明确指标、日志、追踪、告警和故障定位要求。",
      "value_type": "multi_select"
    }
  ],
  "terms": [
    {
      "id": "caller-key",
      "term": "调用方提供的操作编号",
      "plain_language": "每一笔新操作有自己的编号；重发同一笔时保留编号，内容相同的两笔操作仍可分开。",
      "benefit": "调用方能明确表达是在重发还是创建另一笔。",
      "cost": "双方要管理编号生成、传递、作用范围和生命周期。",
      "dimension_id": "identity"
    },
    {
      "id": "business-key",
      "term": "业务唯一标识",
      "plain_language": "按业务约定的唯一编号识别一笔操作，而不是只看提交内容是否一样。",
      "benefit": "复用已有业务身份，便于核实对应记录。",
      "cost": "编号重用、多次合法修改和不同操作可能冲突，需要业务裁定。",
      "dimension_id": "identity"
    },
    {
      "id": "retry-same-key",
      "term": "同键重试",
      "plain_language": "确认服务支持后，重发同一笔时沿用原编号和原业务内容，不因超时换新编号。",
      "benefit": "减少结果不明时由调用方重复发起新操作的风险。",
      "cost": "需要额外状态、故障恢复与窗口边界设计；不表示所有失败均可重试。",
      "dimension_id": "retry"
    },
    {
      "id": "manual-reconcile",
      "term": "暂停自动重试并核实",
      "plain_language": "先停止自动重复提交，查清原操作是否生效，再由负责人决定后续处理。",
      "benefit": "在重试契约尚不明确时避免直接重复提交。",
      "cost": "恢复较慢且需要人员参与；查询本身未必足以消除所有不确定性。",
      "dimension_id": "retry"
    },
    {
      "id": "reject-mismatch",
      "term": "拒绝同身份内容不一致",
      "plain_language": "同一编号再次提交时，约定参与比较的内容变了就拒绝，不悄悄覆盖原操作。",
      "benefit": "暴露编号误用或不同业务意图。",
      "cost": "需要保存可核对信息，调用方还要处理拒绝和业务修改流程。",
      "dimension_id": "payload"
    },
    {
      "id": "report-in-progress",
      "term": "告知原操作处理中",
      "plain_language": "原操作还在做，就告诉后来者仍在处理，不再启动一份，也不假装已经成功。",
      "benefit": "调用方可以区分处理中与已完成。",
      "cost": "需要处理中状态及后续获取结果的契约。",
      "dimension_id": "concurrency"
    },
    {
      "id": "reject-in-progress",
      "term": "拒绝处理中重复请求",
      "plain_language": "原操作还在做时，明确拒绝这次重复提交；这不说明原操作失败了。",
      "benefit": "并发冲突明确暴露给调用方。",
      "cost": "调用方需要处理冲突和后续核实，不能把拒绝当作可换新编号的证据。",
      "dimension_id": "concurrency"
    },
    {
      "id": "record-result",
      "term": "保存可关联的操作结果",
      "plain_language": "留下这笔操作的处理结果或可查询结果的关联记录，让重发者能知道原操作的结果。",
      "benefit": "减少重复请求对原操作归属和结果的疑问。",
      "cost": "需要结果存储或可恢复关联，并处理隐私、生命周期及状态变化。",
      "dimension_id": "protection"
    },
    {
      "id": "atomic-record",
      "term": "识别记录与业务变更原子生效",
      "plain_language": "在约定的服务写入边界内，操作识别记录与业务变更要么一起生效，要么都不生效。",
      "benefit": "避免仅记住编号却未写入，或已写入却没有识别记录的间隙。",
      "cost": "需要一致性与故障恢复设计和失败测试，不是加一个键就实现。",
      "dimension_id": "protection"
    },
    {
      "id": "ha-redundancy",
      "term": "故障域冗余",
      "plain_language": "关键组件跨实例、节点或可用区部署，单点故障不直接中断服务。",
      "benefit": "提高故障承受能力。",
      "cost": "成本、部署和数据一致性复杂度增加。",
      "dimension_id": "availability"
    },
    {
      "id": "ha-failover",
      "term": "故障转移与恢复目标",
      "plain_language": "明确 RTO、RPO、健康检查和切换方式。",
      "benefit": "把高可用从口号变成可验证目标。",
      "cost": "需要演练和监控。",
      "dimension_id": "availability"
    },
    {
      "id": "capacity-rps",
      "term": "请求速率模型",
      "plain_language": "用平均值、峰值、突发和增长率描述流量，而不是只说“高并发”。",
      "benefit": "容量评估有输入依据。",
      "cost": "需要真实或合理的流量数据。",
      "dimension_id": "capacity"
    },
    {
      "id": "capacity-p95",
      "term": "P95/P99 延迟目标",
      "plain_language": "明确接口、负载、统计窗口和 P95/P99 延迟目标。",
      "benefit": "性能目标可测量。",
      "cost": "目标越高，资源成本越大。",
      "dimension_id": "capacity"
    },
    {
      "id": "scale-horizontal",
      "term": "水平扩展",
      "plain_language": "通过增加无状态实例分摊请求。",
      "benefit": "适合持续增长和弹性流量。",
      "cost": "需要处理共享状态和数据瓶颈。",
      "dimension_id": "scalability"
    },
    {
      "id": "scale-sharding",
      "term": "分片扩展",
      "plain_language": "按租户、业务键或范围拆分数据与负载。",
      "benefit": "突破单库或单节点容量边界。",
      "cost": "跨分片查询和迁移更复杂。",
      "dimension_id": "scalability"
    },
    {
      "id": "resilience-timeout",
      "term": "超时与限时",
      "plain_language": "为依赖调用设置明确超时和截止时间。",
      "benefit": "避免线程或连接长期占用。",
      "cost": "过短会增加失败率。",
      "dimension_id": "resilience"
    },
    {
      "id": "resilience-circuit",
      "term": "熔断与降级",
      "plain_language": "依赖异常时停止放大故障，并返回受控的降级结果。",
      "benefit": "降低级联故障风险。",
      "cost": "部分功能不可用，需明确用户体验。",
      "dimension_id": "resilience"
    },
    {
      "id": "obs-sli",
      "term": "SLI/SLO 指标",
      "plain_language": "用可用性、延迟、错误率等指标和目标描述服务状态。",
      "benefit": "告警和改进有依据。",
      "cost": "需要稳定采集和误差预算。",
      "dimension_id": "observability"
    },
    {
      "id": "obs-trace",
      "term": "分布式追踪",
      "plain_language": "为跨服务请求关联 trace 和 span。",
      "benefit": "更快定位链路瓶颈。",
      "cost": "采集、存储和隐私治理成本增加。",
      "dimension_id": "observability"
    }
  ],
  "mappings": [

{
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "package_id": "uiux-core",
  "domain_id": "digital-product-uiux",
  "title": "网页 UI/UX 需求澄清术语包",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "status": "published",
  "intents": [
    {
      "id": "design-page",
      "action": "设计",
      "object": "网页页面"
    },
    {
      "id": "diagnose-usability",
      "action": "排查",
      "object": "页面使用问题"
    }
  ],
  "dimensions": [
    {
      "id": "density",
      "name": "信息密度",
      "definition": "单位屏幕或版面承载的信息量、留白和层级节奏。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "typography",
      "name": "字体与文字层级",
      "definition": "字体家族、字重、字号、行高和标题正文层级的组合。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "contrast",
      "name": "对比度方向",
      "definition": "文字、背景、边界和重点元素之间的明暗与色彩区分。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "consistency",
      "name": "组件一致性",
      "definition": "按钮、表单、卡片、间距和状态反馈是否遵循统一规则。",
      "value_type": "selection"
    },
    {
      "id": "symptom",
      "name": "使用现象",
      "definition": "用户观察到的具体操作困难或视觉问题。",
      "value_type": "free_text"
    }
  ],
  "terms": [
    {
      "id": "density-focused",
      "term": "高密度信息布局",
      "plain_language": "同一屏展示更多有效信息，减少装饰性留白。",
      "benefit": "适合后台、数据和效率型页面。",
      "cost": "信息拥挤时阅读压力更高。",
      "dimension_id": "density"
    },
    {
      "id": "density-balanced",
      "term": "平衡型信息布局",
      "plain_language": "重点内容清楚，信息量和留白保持中等。",
      "benefit": "适合多数产品页面，取舍较均衡。",
      "cost": "个性和视觉冲击较弱。",
      "dimension_id": "density"
    },
    {
      "id": "density-breathing",
      "term": "留白呼吸型布局",
      "plain_language": "减少同屏信息，让内容之间有明显空间。",
      "benefit": "更轻松、更强调单项内容。",
      "cost": "用户需要更多滚动或跳转。",
      "dimension_id": "density"
    },
    {
      "id": "type-song",
      "term": "宋体正文层级",
      "plain_language": "使用宋体或同类衬线字体组织中文正文和标题层级。",
      "benefit": "更有编辑感和传统阅读气质。",
      "cost": "小字号和复杂终端上可能需要额外可读性检查。",
      "dimension_id": "typography"
    },
    {
      "id": "type-sans",
      "term": "无衬线字体层级",
      "plain_language": "使用无衬线字体建立清晰、现代的文字层级。",
      "benefit": "屏幕阅读和界面扫描通常更直接。",
      "cost": "文化和编辑气质较弱。",
      "dimension_id": "typography"
    },
    {
      "id": "contrast-high",
      "term": "高对比度",
      "plain_language": "提高文字、背景和重点控件的明暗区分。",
      "benefit": "重点更容易被发现，适合信息复杂页面。",
      "cost": "色彩更强，柔和感会降低。",
      "dimension_id": "contrast"
    },
    {
      "id": "contrast-soft",
      "term": "柔和对比度",
      "plain_language": "降低明暗和色彩冲突，让整体更柔和。",
      "benefit": "视觉压力较低，适合内容展示。",
      "cost": "弱化后可能影响信息分级。",
      "dimension_id": "contrast"
    },
    {
      "id": "consistency-system",
      "term": "统一组件规则",
      "plain_language": "按钮、卡片、间距、状态和交互反馈使用同一套规则。",
      "benefit": "多页面体验更稳定，后续维护成本更低。",
      "cost": "前期需要建立并遵守设计系统。",
      "dimension_id": "consistency"
    },
    {
      "id": "consistency-expressive",
      "term": "局部表达变化",
      "plain_language": "允许重点页面或品牌区域使用有限的组件变化。",
      "benefit": "更有个性，适合品牌展示页。",
      "cost": "跨页面学习成本和维护复杂度上升。",
      "dimension_id": "consistency"
    }
  ],
  "mappings": [
    {
      "expression": "有质感",
      "level": "L3",
      "intent_ids": [
